description: Official procedure facts for Maltese citizens and their families, in Malta and abroad: (1) passport renewal (Identità fees by age and season, the official 4-hour urgent service in Malta, applying through a mission abroad, minors, lost/stolen); (2) a newborn's birth registration, citizenship and first passport (born in Malta or abroad to a Maltese parent); (3) a foreign spouse's citizenship by marriage (Cap. 188 art. 6, Form B, 5-year rule); (4) registration by descent (art. 5(3), Forms K and M, two consecutive Malta-born generations; the 1 August 2028 dates concern the parent or ancestor, not an application deadline). Returns steps, documents, itemised fees with source and verified flag, timelines, the authority, missions for the residence country and how Mirabello prepares the file. NOT investment citizenship (Malta's investor programme closed in 2025). Omit service for an overview. Information, not legal advice.

applicant_age.description: Age in years of the person the passport is for (passport service only); selects the minors rules and fee band.

residence_country.description: Where the applicant lives now, as a country name or ISO code (e.g. "Australia", "GB", "Malta"). Selects the in-Malta or abroad procedure and the nearest Maltese missions.

service.description: Which service: "passport-renewal" (renew a Maltese passport), "newborn" (register a birth, prove citizenship, first passport), "marriage" (foreign spouse of a Maltese citizen), "descent" (planned). Omit for an overview of all services.
